info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Summarys-v2-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Summary API provides insights into the current state of user shopping carts across the ecommerce platform. This endpoint allows developers to swiftly retrieve a summary of items in each user's cart, including quantity, pricing, and totals. Ideal for analytic tools, user interfaces, and customer engagement features, this API helps enhance the shopping experience by enabling real-time cart updates. Typical consumers include app developers, ecommerce managers, and analytics teams looking to optimize user interactions and sales strategies.

get.description: Fetch the current contents and total value of the user's shopping cart, providing an overview of items and pricing.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the cart summary. This should include any necessary identifiers or filters relevant to the user's cart.

204.description: Request successfully processed, no content to return.

ListEcommerceCartSummarysRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for obtaining the summary of a shopping cart. It is represented as a string.
